replace:
await startApp(options.root, { ...WORKERS, port: workers }, options.waitSeconds);
    return 0;
note: Two blocks of the workers stage keep their titles and change one assertion each, because the run now starts the administration portal once the workers answer, so the workers' answers line and stop line are no longer the last lines it prints: each block expected stdout to end with them, and now expects them followed by the portal's answers line (for the second run, the line of a portal this command started earlier). The base file of 2dee8416 fails against this command on these two blocks and on 25 others, every one a block whose run reaches the end of the sequence and expects it to succeed: the base suite's checkout holds no apps/admin/package.json, from which the command now reads the portal's port, and its pnpm stand-in has no branch for the portal, so each of those runs ends at the portal's stage with exit 1. Those blocks are listed here, with their bodies unchanged at the head, so that the clean runs alone give the verdict; at the head the suite passes. The suite runs the command as a child process, which this tool's in-memory mutation does not reach, so the search and replace of this case, which would stop the run after the workers as the base command did, are never applied to the runs that decide it.
